_comment: Fill one copy of this template per checkpoint ratification. Store completed receipts at docs/receipts/ratification-YYYY-MM-DD-checkpointNNNN.json. This template documents both the happy path and the degraded fallback path so each drill produces a standardized artifact, not terminal narration.

token_path.comment: Paste the ::notice:: or ::warning:: line from the 'Log PR token source' step

checks.comment: List the check names and conclusions as shown on the PR page

proof_claims.checkpoint_cryptographic_integrity: proven — Ed25519 signature verified by checkpoint-validate
proof_claims.checkpoint_ci_origin: proven — T1 signer (assay-ci) requires LEDGER_SIGNING_KEY secret in Actions

degraded_path_notes._comment: Complete this section only when ratification_path=manual_fallback
degraded_path_notes.proof_tier_impact: Checkpoint trust is unaffected (T1 signature still valid). Procedural gap: ratification required a manual synchronize push. This is a ceremony gap, not a cryptographic downgrade.
